```{r Helper function for computing AUPRC from ROC data, include=FALSE}
compute_auprc <- function(disc_rds, cal_rds) {
  roc <- disc_rds$plot$data
  d <- cal_rds$dist$data
  p <- d$n[d$obs == "1"] / sum(d$n)
  precision <- (roc$tpr * p) / (roc$tpr * p + (1 - roc$tnr) * (1 - p))
  recall <- roc$tpr
  precision[is.nan(precision)] <- 1
  ord <- order(recall, precision)
  recall <- recall[ord]
  precision <- precision[ord]
  idx <- !duplicated(recall)
  recall <- recall[idx]
  precision <- precision[idx]
  sum(diff(recall) * (precision[-1] + precision[-length(precision)]) / 2, na.rm = TRUE)
}

extract_metrics_for_model <- function(prefix, eval_dir, ont_name_file = NULL) {
  # Get all discrimination files (root + ontology)
  all_disc <- list.files(eval_dir, pattern = paste0("^", prefix, "_(root|ONT[0-9]+)_discrimination\\.rds$"), full.names = TRUE)

  results <- lapply(all_disc, function(f) {
    node <- str_extract(basename(f), "root|ONT[0-9]+")
    disc <- readRDS(f)
    cal_f <- sub("_discrimination\\.rds$", "_calibration.rds", f)
    cal <- if (file.exists(cal_f)) readRDS(cal_f) else NULL

    auroc <- disc$metrics$estimate
    auroc_ci <- disc$metrics$ci
    auprc <- if (!is.null(cal)) tryCatch(compute_auprc(disc, cal), error = function(e) NA) else NA
    rmse <- if (!is.null(cal)) cal$metrics$estimate[3] else NA
    rmse_ci <- if (!is.null(cal)) cal$metrics$ci[3] else NA

    # Map ONT ID to original
    original_id <- node
    if (!is.null(ont_name_file) && file.exists(ont_name_file) && node != "root") {
      ont_names <- read.csv(ont_name_file)
      ont_colon <- str_replace(node, "ONT", "ONT:")
      m <- ont_names[ont_names$new_oid == ont_colon, ]
      if (nrow(m) > 0) original_id <- m$old_oid[1]
    }

    data.frame(node = node, original_id = original_id,
               auroc = auroc, auroc_ci = auroc_ci,
               auprc = auprc, rmse = rmse, rmse_ci = rmse_ci)
  })

  do.call(rbind, results)
}
```

```{r Helper function for building ontology tree, include=FALSE}
build_tree_order <- function(ontology_csv_path, ont_name_file = NULL) {
  raw <- read.csv(ontology_csv_path, header = FALSE,
                  col.names = c("source", "target", "similarity", "relation"))

  # Separate hierarchy (is_a) and features
  hierarchy <- raw[raw$relation == "is_a", c("source", "target")]
  features <- raw[raw$relation == "feature", c("source", "target")]

  # Find root: target that's never a source in hierarchy
  all_parents <- unique(hierarchy$target)
  all_children <- unique(hierarchy$source)
  root_node <- setdiff(all_parents, all_children)
  if (length(root_node) == 0) root_node <- all_parents[1]
  root_node <- root_node[1]

  # Get genes per ontology node
  genes_per_node <- split(features$source, features$target)

  # Map ONT IDs to original names
  ont_map <- setNames(nm = unique(c(hierarchy$source, hierarchy$target)))
  if (!is.null(ont_name_file) && file.exists(ont_name_file)) {
    ont_names <- read.csv(ont_name_file)
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(ont_names))) {
      ont_map[ont_names$new_oid[j]] <- ont_names$old_oid[j]
    }
  }

  # Build children map
  children_of <- split(hierarchy$source, hierarchy$target)

  # DFS traversal to get tree order with prefixes
  result <- list()
  dfs <- function(node, prefix, is_last) {
    mapped <- if (!is.null(ont_map[node]) && !is.na(ont_map[node])) ont_map[node] else node
    # Strip ONT: prefix for matching with eval files
    eval_node <- gsub(":", "", node)

    genes <- genes_per_node[[node]]
    genes_vec <- if (!is.null(genes) && length(genes) > 0) genes else character(0)
    gene_str <- if (length(genes_vec) > 0) paste0(" (", paste(genes_vec, collapse=", "), ")") else ""

    label <- paste0(mapped, gene_str)

    if (node == root_node) {
      display <- paste0(label, gene_str)
      eval_id <- eval_node
    } else {
      connector <- if (is_last) "\U2514\U2500\U2500 " else "\U251C\U2500\U2500 "
      display <- paste0(prefix, connector, label)
      eval_id <- eval_node
    }

    result[[length(result) + 1]] <<- list(display = display, eval_node = eval_id, genes = genes_vec)

    kids <- children_of[[node]]
    if (!is.null(kids) && length(kids) > 0) {
      kids <- sort(kids)
      for (k in seq_along(kids)) {
        child_is_last <- (k == length(kids))
        new_prefix <- if (node == root_node) {
          ""
        } else {
          paste0(prefix, if (is_last) "    " else "\U2502   ")
        }
        dfs(kids[k], new_prefix, child_is_last)
      }
    }
  }

  dfs(root_node, "", TRUE)
  data.frame(
    display = sapply(result, \(x) x$display),
    eval_node = sapply(result, \(x) x$eval_node),
    genes = I(lapply(result, \(x) x$genes)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

```{r Helper function for grad-CAM criterion 3, include=FALSE}
compute_gradcam_eligible <- function(model_prefix) {
  gradcam_file <- paste0("data/gradcam/", model_prefix, ".csv")
  tidyset_file <- paste0("data/tidyset/", model_prefix, "_target.ts.tar.gz")

  if (!file.exists(gradcam_file) || !file.exists(tidyset_file)) return(NULL)

  # Read grad-CAM heatmap and add +1 to match ontotype 1-indexing (pec.Rmd line 10961)
  gc <- read.csv(gradcam_file, header = TRUE)
  colnames(gc) <- c("ontology", "x", "y", "z", "value")
  gc$x <- gc$x + 1
  gc$y <- gc$y + 1
  gc$z <- gc$z + 1

  # Clean up any previous extraction
  extract_dir <- sub("\\.ts\\.tar\\.gz$", "", tidyset_file)
  if (dir.exists(extract_dir)) unlink(extract_dir, recursive = TRUE)

  # Read TidySet and extract ontotype
  ts <- TidySet.read(tidyset_file)
  ontotype <- notes(experimentData(ts))[["ontotype"]]

  # Clean up extracted directory
  if (dir.exists(extract_dir)) unlink(extract_dir, recursive = TRUE)

  # Build gene → ontology → coordinate mapping from ontotype
  gene_gc_list <- lapply(names(ontotype), function(ont_id) {
    ot <- ontotype[[ont_id]]
    if (is.null(ot) || nrow(ot) == 0) return(NULL)
    df <- as.data.frame(ot)
    df$feature <- rownames(ot)
    df$ontology <- ont_id
    df
  })
  gene_coords <- do.call(rbind, gene_gc_list)
  if (is.null(gene_coords) || nrow(gene_coords) == 0) return(NULL)

  # Join with grad-CAM values
  gene_gc <- merge(gene_coords, gc, by = c("ontology", "x", "y", "z"), all.x = TRUE)
  gene_gc$value[is.na(gene_gc$value)] <- 0

  # Filter to value > 0 (matching pec.Rmd line 11093)
  gene_gc <- gene_gc[gene_gc$value > 0, ]

  eligible <- list()
  for (ont_id in unique(gene_gc$ontology)) {
    sub <- gene_gc[gene_gc$ontology == ont_id, ]
    if (nrow(sub) == 0) next
    q975 <- quantile(sub$value, 0.975)
    genes_above <- sub$feature[sub$value > q975]
    if (length(genes_above) > 0) {
      eligible[[ont_id]] <- as.character(genes_above)
    }
  }

  eligible
}
```

  if (!file.exists(ts_file)) return(NULL)

```{r Helper functions for threshold tables, include=FALSE}
fmt_cm <- function(x, lb, ub) ifelse(is.nan(x) | is.na(x), "—", sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f, %.1f)", x, lb, ub))

fmt_pair <- function(a_avg, a_lb, a_ub, b_avg, b_lb, b_ub) {
  paste0(fmt_cm(a_avg, a_lb, a_ub), " / ", fmt_cm(b_avg, b_lb, b_ub))
}

get_metric <- function(thr_rds, m) {
  list(avg = thr_rds$avg[thr_rds$metric == m],
       lb = thr_rds$lb[thr_rds$metric == m],
       ub = thr_rds$ub[thr_rds$metric == m])
}

extract_thr_for_model <- function(prefix, eval_dir, ont_name_file = NULL) {
  all_thr <- list.files(eval_dir, pattern = paste0("^", prefix, "_(root|ONT[0-9]+)_thresholding\\.rds$"), full.names = TRUE)

  lapply(all_thr, function(f) {
    node <- str_extract(basename(f), "root|ONT[0-9]+")
    thr <- readRDS(f)
    dec_f <- sub("_thresholding\\.rds$", "_decision.rds", f)
    dec <- if (file.exists(dec_f)) readRDS(dec_f) else NULL

    original_id <- node
    if (!is.null(ont_name_file) && file.exists(ont_name_file) && node != "root") {
      ont_names <- read.csv(ont_name_file)
      ont_colon <- str_replace(node, "ONT", "ONT:")
      m <- ont_names[ont_names$new_oid == ont_colon, ]
      if (nrow(m) > 0) original_id <- m$old_oid[1]
    }

    threshold <- thr$ref_value[1]
    nb_model <- thr$avg[thr$metric == "nb"]
    nb_ref <- NA
    if (!is.null(dec) && length(dec$plot$layers) >= 3) {
      ta <- dec$plot$layers[[3]]$data
      nb_treat_all <- ta$intercept + ta$slope * threshold
      nb_ref <- max(nb_treat_all, 0)
    }

    list(node = node, original_id = original_id, thr = thr,
         threshold = threshold, nb_model = nb_model, nb_ref = nb_ref)
  })
}
```

```{r Filter grad-CAM eligible to reported set per model, include=FALSE}
# For each model, among C1+C2+C3-passing ontologies:
# 1. Remove ontologies whose eligible gene set is a strict subset of another's
# 2. Among identical gene sets, keep the first in tree traversal order
gradcam_eligible <- setNames(lapply(seq_len(nrow(models)), function(i) {
  prefix <- models$model_prefix[i]
  gc_raw <- gradcam_eligible_raw[[prefix]]
  if (is.null(gc_raw) || length(gc_raw) == 0) return(gc_raw)

  ont_name_file <- paste0("data/ontology/", prefix, ".csv")
  dev_nodes_raw <- extract_thr_for_model(prefix, "data/eval_train/", ont_name_file)
  test_nodes <- extract_thr_for_model(prefix, "data/eval/", ont_name_file)
  test_by_node <- setNames(test_nodes, sapply(test_nodes, \(x) x$node))

  c1c2_nodes <- c()
  vtype <- models$validation_criteria[i]
  for (dn in dev_nodes_raw) {
    tn <- test_by_node[[dn$node]]
    d_ppv <- get_metric(dn$thr, "ppv"); d_tpr <- get_metric(dn$thr, "tpr")
    t_ppv <- if (!is.null(tn)) get_metric(tn$thr, "ppv") else list(avg=NA, lb=NA, ub=NA)
    t_tpr <- if (!is.null(tn)) get_metric(tn$thr, "tpr") else list(avg=NA, lb=NA, ub=NA)
    d_npv <- get_metric(dn$thr, "npv"); d_tnr <- get_metric(dn$thr, "tnr")
    t_npv <- if (!is.null(tn)) get_metric(tn$thr, "npv") else list(avg=NA, lb=NA, ub=NA)
    t_tnr <- if (!is.null(tn)) get_metric(tn$thr, "tnr") else list(avg=NA, lb=NA, ub=NA)

    if (vtype == "PPV/TPR") {
      c1 <- isTRUE(is.finite(d_ppv$lb) && d_ppv$lb > 0 && is.finite(d_tpr$lb) && d_tpr$lb > 0 &&
                    is.finite(t_ppv$lb) && t_ppv$lb > 0 && is.finite(t_tpr$lb) && t_tpr$lb > 0)
      c2 <- c1 && isTRUE(!is.nan(d_ppv$avg) && !is.nan(d_tpr$avg) && !is.nan(t_ppv$avg) && !is.nan(t_tpr$avg) &&
                          abs(d_ppv$avg - t_ppv$avg) <= 25 && abs(d_tpr$avg - t_tpr$avg) <= 25)
    } else {
      c1 <- isTRUE(is.finite(d_npv$lb) && d_npv$lb > 0 && is.finite(d_tnr$lb) && d_tnr$lb > 0 &&
                    is.finite(t_npv$lb) && t_npv$lb > 0 && is.finite(t_tnr$lb) && t_tnr$lb > 0)
      c2 <- c1 && isTRUE(!is.nan(d_npv$avg) && !is.nan(d_tnr$avg) && !is.nan(t_npv$avg) && !is.nan(t_tnr$avg) &&
                          abs(d_npv$avg - t_npv$avg) <= 25 && abs(d_tnr$avg - t_tnr$avg) <= 25)
    }
    if (c1 && c2) c1c2_nodes <- c(c1c2_nodes, dn$node)
  }

  c3_nodes <- intersect(names(gc_raw), c1c2_nodes)
  if (length(c3_nodes) == 0) return(gc_raw)

  gene_sets <- lapply(c3_nodes, \(n) sort(gc_raw[[n]]))
  names(gene_sets) <- c3_nodes

  tree_csv <- paste0("data/ontology_tree/", prefix, ".csv")
  tree_order_nodes <- if (file.exists(tree_csv)) {
    build_tree_order(tree_csv, ont_name_file)$eval_node
  } else character(0)
  all_ordered <- c("root", tree_order_nodes)
  all_ordered <- all_ordered[!duplicated(all_ordered)]

  # Step 1: Subset removal
  keep <- rep(TRUE, length(c3_nodes))
  for (a in seq_along(c3_nodes)) {
    if (!keep[a]) next
    gs_a <- gene_sets[[a]]
    for (b in seq_along(c3_nodes)) {
      if (a == b || !keep[b]) next
      gs_b <- gene_sets[[b]]
      if (length(gs_a) < length(gs_b) && all(gs_a %in% gs_b)) {
        keep[a] <- FALSE
        break
      }
    }
  }
  surviving <- c3_nodes[keep]
  surviving_genes <- gene_sets[keep]

  # Step 2: Dedup — among identical gene sets, keep first in tree order
  final_nodes <- c()
  seen_sets <- list()
  surv_order <- match(surviving, all_ordered)
  surv_order[is.na(surv_order)] <- Inf
  surviving <- surviving[order(surv_order)]
  surviving_genes <- surviving_genes[order(surv_order)]
  for (k in seq_along(surviving)) {
    gs_key <- paste(surviving_genes[[k]], collapse = ",")
    if (!gs_key %in% seen_sets) {
      seen_sets <- c(seen_sets, gs_key)
      final_nodes <- c(final_nodes, surviving[k])
    }
  }

  gc_raw[intersect(names(gc_raw), final_nodes)]
}), models$model_prefix)
```

```{r Per-model combined tables, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
fmt_auroc <- function(a, ci) sprintf("%.3f (%.3f, %.3f)", a, a - ci, a + ci)
fmt_val <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "—", sprintf("%.3f", x))
fmt_rmse <- function(r, ci) ifelse(is.na(r), "—", sprintf("%.3f (±%.4f)", r, ci))

item_num <- 0  # sequential counter for all figures and tables

for (i in 1:nrow(disc_cal_data)) {
  m <- disc_cal_data[i, ]
  section_title <- paste0(m$pe_subtype, " — ", m$associated_factor,
                           " (Fig ", m$figure_ref, ", ", m$ontology_type, ")")

  cat(sprintf("\n# %s\n\n", section_title))

  # --- Build tree order ---
  ont_name_file <- paste0("data/ontology/", m$model_prefix, ".csv")
  tree_csv <- paste0("data/ontology_tree/", m$model_prefix, ".csv")
  tree_order <- if (file.exists(tree_csv)) build_tree_order(tree_csv, ont_name_file) else NULL

  # --- Build reported-ontology mapping ---
  # For each node, find which reported ontology (B) it maps to:
  # - If the node IS reported: maps to itself
  # - If the node has C3-eligible genes (raw) that are a subset of a reported one: maps to that
  # - Otherwise: empty
  gc_eligible <- gradcam_eligible[[m$model_prefix]]
  gc_raw <- gradcam_eligible_raw[[m$model_prefix]]
  reported_nodes <- if (!is.null(gc_eligible)) names(gc_eligible) else character(0)

  # Load ontology name mapping for display
  ont_names_df <- if (file.exists(ont_name_file)) read.csv(ont_name_file) else NULL
  node_to_display <- function(eval_node) {
    if (eval_node == "root") return("root")
    if (!is.null(ont_names_df)) {
      colon_form <- sub("ONT", "ONT:", eval_node)
      row <- ont_names_df[ont_names_df$new_oid == colon_form, ]
      if (nrow(row) > 0) return(row$old_oid[1])
    }
    eval_node
  }

  get_reported_label <- function(node) {
    if (node %in% reported_nodes) return(node_to_display(node))
    if (!is.null(gc_raw) && node %in% names(gc_raw)) {
      node_genes <- sort(gc_raw[[node]])
      for (rn in reported_nodes) {
        rn_genes <- sort(gc_eligible[[rn]])
        if (all(node_genes %in% rn_genes)) return(node_to_display(rn))
      }
      # Dedup case: identical gene set
      for (rn in reported_nodes) {
        rn_genes <- sort(gc_eligible[[rn]])
        if (identical(node_genes, rn_genes)) return(node_to_display(rn))
      }
    }
    ""
  }

  # --- Table A: Threshold values and confusion matrices ---
  dev_nodes_raw <- extract_thr_for_model(m$model_prefix, "data/eval_train/", ont_name_file)
  test_nodes <- extract_thr_for_model(m$model_prefix, "data/eval/", ont_name_file)

  # Deduplicate and sort: root first, then by node name
  seen <- c()
  dev_nodes <- list()
  # Add root first if exists
  for (dn in dev_nodes_raw) {
    if (dn$node == "root" && !"root" %in% seen) {
      dev_nodes <- c(dev_nodes, list(dn)); seen <- c(seen, "root")
    }
  }
  # Add tree-ordered nodes
  if (!is.null(tree_order)) {
    for (ev in tree_order$eval_node) {
      if (ev %in% seen) next
      for (dn in dev_nodes_raw) {
        if (dn$node == ev) { dev_nodes <- c(dev_nodes, list(dn)); seen <- c(seen, ev); break }
      }
    }
  }
  # Add any remaining nodes not in tree
  for (dn in dev_nodes_raw) {
    if (dn$node %in% seen) next
    dev_nodes <- c(dev_nodes, list(dn)); seen <- c(seen, dn$node)
  }
  test_by_node <- setNames(test_nodes, sapply(test_nodes, \(x) x$node))

  # --- Bar plot: NB Model vs NB Ref per ontology (same order as table rows) ---
  # Collect labels from the table rows (first row of each ontology pair)
  nb_labels <- c()
  nb_models <- c()
  nb_refs <- c()
  seen_nodes <- c()
  for (dn in dev_nodes) {
    if (dn$node %in% seen_nodes) next
    seen_nodes <- c(seen_nodes, dn$node)
    # Get tree display without genes, add threshold
    label <- dn$original_id
    if (!is.null(tree_order)) {
      idx <- match(dn$node, tree_order$eval_node)
      if (!is.na(idx)) {
        raw_display <- tree_order$display[idx]
        label <- sub(" \\(.*\\)$", "", raw_display)
      }
    }
    if (dn$node == "root" && label == dn$original_id) label <- "root"
    label <- paste0(label, " [th=", sprintf("%.2f", dn$threshold), "]")
    nb_labels <- c(nb_labels, label)
    nb_models <- c(nb_models, ifelse(is.nan(dn$nb_model), 0, dn$nb_model))
    nb_refs <- c(nb_refs, ifelse(is.na(dn$nb_ref), 0, dn$nb_ref))
  }
  nb_plot_data <- data.frame(ontology = nb_labels, nb_model = nb_models, nb_ref = nb_refs)
  nb_plot_data$ontology <- factor(nb_plot_data$ontology, levels = rev(nb_plot_data$ontology))

  nb_long <- nb_plot_data |>
    select(ontology, nb_model, nb_ref) |>
    pivot_longer(cols = c(nb_model, nb_ref), names_to = "type", values_to = "nb") |>
    mutate(type = factor(type, levels = c("nb_ref", "nb_model"), labels = c("NB Ref", "NB Model")))

  n_nodes <- nrow(nb_plot_data)
  fig_height <- min(48, max(2, n_nodes * 0.18 + 1))

  item_num <- item_num + 1
  nb_fig_num <- item_num
  nb_plot <- ggplot(nb_long, aes(x = nb, y = ontology, fill = type)) +
    geom_col(position = "identity", width = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("NB Ref" = "grey70", "NB Model" = "steelblue")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    labs(x = "Net benefit (dev set)", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(family = "mono", size = 9, hjust = 0),
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  plot_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
  ggsave(plot_file, nb_plot, width = 10, height = fig_height, dpi = 150)
  cat(sprintf('\n\n<img src="data:image/png;base64,%s" width="100%%"/>\n\n',
    base64enc::base64encode(plot_file)))
  cat(sprintf("**Figure %d.** Net benefit of model vs. reference at selected thresholds — %s.\n\n",
    nb_fig_num, section_title))
  cat("\n\n")

  rows <- list()
  for (dn in dev_nodes) {
    tn <- test_by_node[[dn$node]]

    # PPV/TPR pair
    d_ppv <- get_metric(dn$thr, "ppv"); d_tpr <- get_metric(dn$thr, "tpr")
    t_ppv <- if (!is.null(tn)) get_metric(tn$thr, "ppv") else list(avg=NA, lb=NA, ub=NA)
    t_tpr <- if (!is.null(tn)) get_metric(tn$thr, "tpr") else list(avg=NA, lb=NA, ub=NA)

    # NPV/TNR pair
    d_npv <- get_metric(dn$thr, "npv"); d_tnr <- get_metric(dn$thr, "tnr")
    t_npv <- if (!is.null(tn)) get_metric(tn$thr, "npv") else list(avg=NA, lb=NA, ub=NA)
    t_tnr <- if (!is.null(tn)) get_metric(tn$thr, "tnr") else list(avg=NA, lb=NA, ub=NA)

    # C1 per pair
    c1_pt <- isTRUE(is.finite(d_ppv$lb) && d_ppv$lb > 0 && is.finite(d_tpr$lb) && d_tpr$lb > 0 &&
                    is.finite(t_ppv$lb) && t_ppv$lb > 0 && is.finite(t_tpr$lb) && t_tpr$lb > 0)
    c1_nt <- isTRUE(is.finite(d_npv$lb) && d_npv$lb > 0 && is.finite(d_tnr$lb) && d_tnr$lb > 0 &&
                    is.finite(t_npv$lb) && t_npv$lb > 0 && is.finite(t_tnr$lb) && t_tnr$lb > 0)

    # C2 per pair
    c2_pt <- isTRUE(!is.nan(d_ppv$avg) && !is.nan(d_tpr$avg) && !is.nan(t_ppv$avg) && !is.nan(t_tpr$avg) &&
                    abs(d_ppv$avg - t_ppv$avg) <= 25 && abs(d_tpr$avg - t_tpr$avg) <= 25)
    c2_nt <- isTRUE(!is.nan(d_npv$avg) && !is.nan(d_tnr$avg) && !is.nan(t_npv$avg) && !is.nan(t_tnr$avg) &&
                    abs(d_npv$avg - t_npv$avg) <= 25 && abs(d_tnr$avg - t_tnr$avg) <= 25)

    # C3
    gc_eligible <- gradcam_eligible[[m$model_prefix]]
    valid_c3 <- isTRUE(if (!is.null(gc_eligible) && length(gc_eligible) > 0) dn$node %in% names(gc_eligible) else FALSE)

    c1_str <- paste0(if (c1_pt) "\U2713" else "", "|", if (c1_nt) "\U2713" else "")
    c2_str <- paste0(if (c1_pt && c2_pt) "\U2713" else "", "|", if (c1_nt && c2_nt) "\U2713" else "")
    c3_str <- if (valid_c3) "\U2713" else ""

    # C4: LB AUC-ROC > 0.5 in both dev and test
    disc_dev_f <- paste0("data/eval_train/", m$model_prefix, "_", dn$node, "_discrimination.rds")
    disc_test_f <- paste0("data/eval/", m$model_prefix, "_", dn$node, "_discrimination.rds")
    c4_val <- if (file.exists(disc_dev_f) && file.exists(disc_test_f)) {
      disc_dev <- readRDS(disc_dev_f)
      disc_test <- readRDS(disc_test_f)
      dev_lb <- disc_dev$metrics$estimate - disc_dev$metrics$ci
      test_lb <- disc_test$metrics$estimate - disc_test$metrics$ci
      isTRUE(dev_lb > 0.5 && test_lb > 0.5)
    } else FALSE
    c4_str <- if (c4_val) "\U2713" else ""

    # Tree display with genes
    tree_display <- dn$original_id
    ont_genes_list <- ontotype_genes[[m$model_prefix]]
    eligible_genes <- if (!is.null(gc_eligible)) gc_eligible[[dn$node]] else character(0)
    node_genes <- if (!is.null(ont_genes_list)) ont_genes_list[[dn$node]] else character(0)

    if (!is.null(tree_order)) {
      idx <- match(dn$node, tree_order$eval_node)
      if (!is.na(idx)) {
        if (is.null(node_genes) || length(node_genes) == 0) node_genes <- tree_order$genes[[idx]]
        raw_display <- tree_order$display[idx]
        raw_no_genes <- sub(" \\(.*\\)$", "", raw_display)
      } else {
        raw_no_genes <- dn$node
      }
    } else {
      raw_no_genes <- dn$node
    }

    if (length(node_genes) > 0) {
      marked_genes <- sapply(node_genes, \(g) if (g %in% eligible_genes) paste0(g, "\U2020") else g)
      gene_str <- paste0(" (", paste(marked_genes, collapse = ", "), ")")
    } else {
      gene_str <- ""
    }
    tree_display <- paste0(raw_no_genes, gene_str)

    reported_str <- get_reported_label(dn$node)

    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Ontology = tree_display,
      `PPV/TPR (Dev)` = fmt_pair(d_ppv$avg, d_ppv$lb, d_ppv$ub, d_tpr$avg, d_tpr$lb, d_tpr$ub),
      `PPV/TPR (Test)` = fmt_pair(t_ppv$avg, t_ppv$lb, t_ppv$ub, t_tpr$avg, t_tpr$lb, t_tpr$ub),
      `NPV/TNR (Dev)` = fmt_pair(d_npv$avg, d_npv$lb, d_npv$ub, d_tnr$avg, d_tnr$lb, d_tnr$ub),
      `NPV/TNR (Test)` = fmt_pair(t_npv$avg, t_npv$lb, t_npv$ub, t_tnr$avg, t_tnr$lb, t_tnr$ub),
      C1 = c1_str, C2 = c2_str, C3 = c3_str, C4 = c4_str,
      Reported = reported_str,
      check.names = FALSE
    )
  }

  tbl_cm <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  cat("\n\n```{=html}\n")
  cat('<div style="overflow-y:auto; max-height:400px; width:100%;">\n')
  cat(
    as.character(
      tbl_cm |>
        kable(caption = paste0("Table ", item_num <- item_num + 1, ". Confusion matrices — ", section_title, "."), format = "html") |>
        kable_classic(full_width = TRUE) |>
        kable_styling(font_size = 12)
    )
  )
  cat('\n</div>\n')
  cat("\n```\n\n")
  cat("**Reported column:** The ontology from the manuscript (Tables 1–2) to which this row's eligible genes belong. An ontology is reported if it passes all three criteria (C1, C2, C3) and its eligible gene set is not a strict subset of another passing ontology's gene set. Rows are empty when the ontology has no eligible genes or does not pass all three criteria.\n\n")

  # --- ROC curves for C1+C2+C3 passing ontologies (dev set) ---
  gc_filt <- gradcam_eligible[[m$model_prefix]]
  c1c2_roc_nodes <- c()
  vtype <- m$validation_criteria
  for (dn in dev_nodes_raw) {
    tn <- test_by_node[[dn$node]]
    d_ppv <- get_metric(dn$thr, "ppv"); d_tpr <- get_metric(dn$thr, "tpr")
    t_ppv <- if (!is.null(tn)) get_metric(tn$thr, "ppv") else list(avg=NA, lb=NA, ub=NA)
    t_tpr <- if (!is.null(tn)) get_metric(tn$thr, "tpr") else list(avg=NA, lb=NA, ub=NA)
    d_npv <- get_metric(dn$thr, "npv"); d_tnr <- get_metric(dn$thr, "tnr")
    t_npv <- if (!is.null(tn)) get_metric(tn$thr, "npv") else list(avg=NA, lb=NA, ub=NA)
    t_tnr <- if (!is.null(tn)) get_metric(tn$thr, "tnr") else list(avg=NA, lb=NA, ub=NA)
    if (vtype == "PPV/TPR") {
      c1 <- isTRUE(is.finite(d_ppv$lb) && d_ppv$lb > 0 && is.finite(d_tpr$lb) && d_tpr$lb > 0 &&
                    is.finite(t_ppv$lb) && t_ppv$lb > 0 && is.finite(t_tpr$lb) && t_tpr$lb > 0)
      c2 <- c1 && isTRUE(!is.nan(d_ppv$avg) && !is.nan(d_tpr$avg) && !is.nan(t_ppv$avg) && !is.nan(t_tpr$avg) &&
                          abs(d_ppv$avg - t_ppv$avg) <= 25 && abs(d_tpr$avg - t_tpr$avg) <= 25)
    } else {
      c1 <- isTRUE(is.finite(d_npv$lb) && d_npv$lb > 0 && is.finite(d_tnr$lb) && d_tnr$lb > 0 &&
                    is.finite(t_npv$lb) && t_npv$lb > 0 && is.finite(t_tnr$lb) && t_tnr$lb > 0)
      c2 <- c1 && isTRUE(!is.nan(d_npv$avg) && !is.nan(d_tnr$avg) && !is.nan(t_npv$avg) && !is.nan(t_tnr$avg) &&
                          abs(d_npv$avg - t_npv$avg) <= 25 && abs(d_tnr$avg - t_tnr$avg) <= 25)
    }
    if (c1 && c2) c1c2_roc_nodes <- c(c1c2_roc_nodes, dn$node)
  }

  c123_nodes <- if (!is.null(gc_filt)) intersect(names(gc_filt), c1c2_roc_nodes) else character(0)
  # C4 filter: LB AUC-ROC > 0.5 in both dev and test
  c1234_nodes <- c()
  for (nd in c123_nodes) {
    disc_dev_f <- paste0("data/eval_train/", m$model_prefix, "_", nd, "_discrimination.rds")
    disc_test_f <- paste0("data/eval/", m$model_prefix, "_", nd, "_discrimination.rds")
    if (file.exists(disc_dev_f) && file.exists(disc_test_f)) {
      d_dev <- readRDS(disc_dev_f); d_test <- readRDS(disc_test_f)
      dev_lb <- d_dev$metrics$estimate - d_dev$metrics$ci
      test_lb <- d_test$metrics$estimate - d_test$metrics$ci
      if (isTRUE(dev_lb > 0.5 && test_lb > 0.5)) c1234_nodes <- c(c1234_nodes, nd)
    }
  }

  if (length(c1234_nodes) > 0) {
    roc_dfs <- list()
    for (nd in c1234_nodes) {
      disc_f <- paste0("data/eval_train/", m$model_prefix, "_", nd, "_discrimination.rds")
      disc <- readRDS(disc_f)
      df <- disc$plot$data
      lbl <- node_to_display(nd)
      df$ontology <- lbl
      roc_dfs <- c(roc_dfs, list(df))
    }
    if (length(roc_dfs) > 0) {
      # Binormal smoothing: fit probit(TPR) = a + b * probit(FPR) per ontology
      roc_smooth <- lapply(roc_dfs, function(df) {
        fpr <- 1 - df$tnr
        tpr <- df$tpr
        eps <- 1e-6
        fpr_c <- pmin(pmax(fpr, eps), 1 - eps)
        tpr_c <- pmin(pmax(tpr, eps), 1 - eps)
        # Remove duplicates and constant regions for stable fit
        keep <- !duplicated(fpr_c) & is.finite(qnorm(fpr_c)) & is.finite(qnorm(tpr_c))
        if (sum(keep) < 3) return(data.frame(fpr = c(0, 1), tpr = c(0, 1), ontology = df$ontology[1]))
        fit <- lm(qnorm(tpr_c[keep]) ~ qnorm(fpr_c[keep]))
        fpr_seq <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 200)
        fpr_seq_c <- pmin(pmax(fpr_seq, eps), 1 - eps)
        tpr_seq <- pnorm(coef(fit)[1] + coef(fit)[2] * qnorm(fpr_seq_c))
        tpr_seq[1] <- 0; tpr_seq[200] <- 1
        tpr_seq <- cummax(tpr_seq)
        data.frame(fpr = fpr_seq, tpr = tpr_seq, ontology = df$ontology[1])
      })
      roc_all <- do.call(rbind, roc_smooth)
      p_roc <- ggplot(roc_all, aes(x = fpr, y = tpr, color = ontology)) +
        geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
        geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
        labs(x = "1 - Specificity (FPR)", y = "Sensitivity (TPR)", color = NULL) +
        coord_equal() +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 9), legend.position = "bottom") +
        guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 2, override.aes = list(linewidth = 1)))

      n_curves <- length(unique(roc_all$ontology))
      fig_h <- max(5, 4 + n_curves * 0.3)
      plot_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
      ggsave(plot_file, p_roc, width = 8, height = fig_h, dpi = 150)
      item_num <- item_num + 1
      cat(sprintf('\n\n<img src="data:image/png;base64,%s" width="100%%"/>\n\n',
        base64enc::base64encode(plot_file)))
      cat(sprintf("**Figure %d.** ROC curves for ontologies passing C1–C4 — %s.\n\n", item_num, section_title))
    }
  }

  cat("\n\n<br><br>\n\n")

  # --- Table B: AUROC, AUPRC, and calibration ---
  dev <- m$metrics_dev[[1]]
  test <- m$metrics_test[[1]]

  # Order by tree traversal, with DI-VNN root first
  if (!is.null(tree_order)) {
    root_idx <- which(dev$node == "root" & !"root" %in% tree_order$eval_node)
    dev_order <- match(tree_order$eval_node, dev$node)
    dev_order <- dev_order[!is.na(dev_order)]
    remaining <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(dev)), c(root_idx, dev_order))
    dev <- dev[c(root_idx, dev_order, remaining), ]
  } else {
    dev <- dev |> arrange(node != "root", node)
  }

  test_matched <- dev |>
    select(node) |>
    left_join(test |> select(node, auroc, auroc_ci, auprc, rmse, rmse_ci), by = "node", suffix = c("", "_test"))

  # Use tree display names with ontotype genes and daggers (same as threshold table)
  ontology_labels <- dev$original_id
  ont_genes_list <- ontotype_genes[[m$model_prefix]]
  for (k in seq_along(ontology_labels)) {
    node_k <- dev$node[k]
    node_genes <- if (!is.null(ont_genes_list)) ont_genes_list[[node_k]] else character(0)
    eligible_genes <- if (!is.null(gc_eligible)) gc_eligible[[node_k]] else character(0)

    if (!is.null(tree_order)) {
      idx <- match(node_k, tree_order$eval_node)
      if (!is.na(idx)) {
        if (is.null(node_genes) || length(node_genes) == 0) node_genes <- tree_order$genes[[idx]]
        raw_display <- tree_order$display[idx]
        raw_no_genes <- sub(" \\(.*\\)$", "", raw_display)
      } else {
        raw_no_genes <- node_k
      }
    } else {
      raw_no_genes <- node_k
    }

    if (length(node_genes) > 0) {
      marked_genes <- sapply(node_genes, \(g) if (g %in% eligible_genes) paste0(g, "\U2020") else g)
      gene_str <- paste0(" (", paste(marked_genes, collapse = ", "), ")")
    } else {
      gene_str <- ""
    }
    ontology_labels[k] <- paste0(raw_no_genes, gene_str)
  }

  # Compute C1, C2, C3 for each node in AUROC table (same ✓|✓ format)
  c1_vec <- c(); c2_vec <- c(); c3_vec <- c(); c4_vec <- c()
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(dev))) {
    node_k <- dev$node[k]
    dev_thr_f <- paste0("data/eval_train/", m$model_prefix, "_", node_k, "_thresholding.rds")
    test_thr_f <- paste0("data/eval/", m$model_prefix, "_", node_k, "_thresholding.rds")

    c1_pt <- FALSE; c1_nt <- FALSE; c2_pt <- FALSE; c2_nt <- FALSE
    if (file.exists(dev_thr_f) && file.exists(test_thr_f)) {
      dev_thr <- readRDS(dev_thr_f); test_thr <- readRDS(test_thr_f)
      d_ppv <- get_metric(dev_thr,"ppv"); d_tpr <- get_metric(dev_thr,"tpr")
      t_ppv <- get_metric(test_thr,"ppv"); t_tpr <- get_metric(test_thr,"tpr")
      d_npv <- get_metric(dev_thr,"npv"); d_tnr <- get_metric(dev_thr,"tnr")
      t_npv <- get_metric(test_thr,"npv"); t_tnr <- get_metric(test_thr,"tnr")

      c1_pt <- isTRUE(is.finite(d_ppv$lb) && d_ppv$lb>0 && is.finite(d_tpr$lb) && d_tpr$lb>0 &&
                       is.finite(t_ppv$lb) && t_ppv$lb>0 && is.finite(t_tpr$lb) && t_tpr$lb>0)
      c1_nt <- isTRUE(is.finite(d_npv$lb) && d_npv$lb>0 && is.finite(d_tnr$lb) && d_tnr$lb>0 &&
                       is.finite(t_npv$lb) && t_npv$lb>0 && is.finite(t_tnr$lb) && t_tnr$lb>0)
      c2_pt <- isTRUE(!is.nan(d_ppv$avg) && !is.nan(d_tpr$avg) && !is.nan(t_ppv$avg) && !is.nan(t_tpr$avg) &&
                       abs(d_ppv$avg-t_ppv$avg)<=25 && abs(d_tpr$avg-t_tpr$avg)<=25)
      c2_nt <- isTRUE(!is.nan(d_npv$avg) && !is.nan(d_tnr$avg) && !is.nan(t_npv$avg) && !is.nan(t_tnr$avg) &&
                       abs(d_npv$avg-t_npv$avg)<=25 && abs(d_tnr$avg-t_tnr$avg)<=25)
    }

    c3_k <- isTRUE(if (!is.null(gc_eligible) && length(gc_eligible) > 0) node_k %in% names(gc_eligible) else FALSE)

    # C4: LB AUC-ROC > 0.5 in both dev and test
    disc_dev_k <- paste0("data/eval_train/", m$model_prefix, "_", node_k, "_discrimination.rds")
    disc_test_k <- paste0("data/eval/", m$model_prefix, "_", node_k, "_discrimination.rds")
    c4_k <- if (file.exists(disc_dev_k) && file.exists(disc_test_k)) {
      dk_dev <- readRDS(disc_dev_k); dk_test <- readRDS(disc_test_k)
      dev_lb_k <- dk_dev$metrics$estimate - dk_dev$metrics$ci
      test_lb_k <- dk_test$metrics$estimate - dk_test$metrics$ci
      isTRUE(dev_lb_k > 0.5 && test_lb_k > 0.5)
    } else FALSE

    c1_vec <- c(c1_vec, paste0(if(c1_pt) "\U2713" else "", "|", if(c1_nt) "\U2713" else ""))
    c2_vec <- c(c2_vec, paste0(if(c1_pt && c2_pt) "\U2713" else "", "|", if(c1_nt && c2_nt) "\U2713" else ""))
    c3_vec <- c(c3_vec, if(c3_k) "\U2713" else "")
    c4_vec <- c(c4_vec, if(c4_k) "\U2713" else "")
  }

  # Reported column for AUROC table
  reported_vec <- sapply(dev$node, get_reported_label)

  combined <- data.frame(Ontology = ontology_labels) |>
    cbind(
      data.frame(
        `AUC-ROC (Dev)` = fmt_auroc(dev$auroc, dev$auroc_ci),
        `AUC-ROC (Test)` = fmt_auroc(test_matched$auroc, test_matched$auroc_ci),
        `AUC-PRC (Dev)` = fmt_val(dev$auprc),
        `AUC-PRC (Test)` = fmt_val(test_matched$auprc),
        `RMSE (Dev)` = fmt_rmse(dev$rmse, dev$rmse_ci),
        `RMSE (Test)` = fmt_rmse(test_matched$rmse, test_matched$rmse_ci),
        C1 = c1_vec, C2 = c2_vec, C3 = c3_vec, C4 = c4_vec,
        Reported = reported_vec,
        check.names = FALSE
      )
    )

  cat("\n\n```{=html}\n")
  cat('<div style="overflow-y:auto; max-height:400px; width:100%;">\n')
  cat(
    as.character(
      combined |>
        kable(caption = paste0("Table ", item_num <- item_num + 1, ". AUROC, AUPRC, and calibration — ", section_title, "."), format = "html") |>
        kable_classic(full_width = TRUE) |>
        kable_styling(font_size = 12)
    )
  )
  cat('\n</div>\n')
  cat("\n```\n\n")
  cat("**Reported column:** The ontology from the manuscript (Tables 1–2) to which this row's eligible genes belong. An ontology is reported if it passes all three criteria (C1, C2, C3) and its eligible gene set is not a strict subset of another passing ontology's gene set. Rows are empty when the ontology has no eligible genes or does not pass all three criteria.\n\n")

  cat("\n\n")
}
```

# Training-validation convergence

```{r Load convergence data, include=FALSE}
conv_data <- models |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    hist_file = paste0("data/history/", model_prefix, "_history.csv"),
    history = list(if (file.exists(hist_file)) read_csv(hist_file, show_col_types = FALSE) else NULL)
  ) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r Convergence plots, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8, warning=FALSE}
conv_plots <- conv_data |>
  filter(!map_lgl(history, is.null)) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(plot = list({
    df <- history |> select(epoch, subset, total_loss)
    ggplot(df, aes(x = epoch, y = total_loss, color = subset)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
      labs(title = paste0("Fig ", figure_ref, ": ", model_id),
           x = "Epoch", y = "Total loss", color = "Set") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("training" = "steelblue", "validation" = "darkred")) +
      theme_minimal() + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10), legend.position = "bottom")
  })) |> pull(plot)
ggarrange(plotlist = conv_plots, ncol = 3, nrow = 3, common.legend = TRUE, legend = "bottom")
```

```{r Convergence AUC plots, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8, warning=FALSE}
conv_auc_plots <- conv_data |>
  filter(!map_lgl(history, is.null)) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(plot = list({
    df <- history |> select(epoch, subset, roc_auc)
    ggplot(df, aes(x = epoch, y = roc_auc, color = subset)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
      labs(title = paste0("Fig ", figure_ref, ": ", model_id),
           x = "Epoch", y = "AUC-ROC", color = "Set") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("training" = "steelblue", "validation" = "darkred")) +
      ylim(0, 1) +
      theme_minimal() + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10), legend.position = "bottom")
  })) |> pull(plot)
ggarrange(plotlist = conv_auc_plots, ncol = 3, nrow = 3, common.legend = TRUE, legend = "bottom")
```
